text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Grrr... ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオ……♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
My, my. What do you have there for us? 
Let me see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？　
私たちになにかくれるの？
なにかしら……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
{0}, isn't this what you climbed the tower in search of?
What a windfall!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君、
これを探して塔を登っていたの？
やったじゃない！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
It's so sparkly and beautiful.
But what an unusual sensation...
text_block_list.orig_text:
きらきら光ってて、
とっても奇麗ね。
なんだか不思議な感じ……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I've brought in a special speaker for today's career guidance.
Her name is Miss Misato Aikawa, and she works at a nursery school.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日の進路指導には、
特別講師を呼んでいるの。
保育園で働いている
愛川美里先生です。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Pleased to meet you. I'm Miss Aikawa.
Today, I'm going to tell you all about my job as a nursery teacher.
I hope you'll learn a lot.
text_block_list.orig_text:
初めまして、
愛川です。
今日は
保育士のお仕事を、
精一杯伝えていきますね。
よろしくお願いします。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Misa—... Ahem. Miss Aikawa and I both graduated from the same junior
college, so I made use of that connection and invited her here today to
give you a special lesson.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みさ……
こほん。
愛川先生とは、
同じ短大の卒業生同士で、
今回はその縁で
特別講師をお願いしたの。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
I'm very happy to be here in Miss Hasekura's classroom.
I hope we can get along well with each other today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
支倉先生のクラスに来られて
とってもうれしいです。
皆さん、
今日は
仲良くしてくださいね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my. {0}, you're one of Miss Hasekura's students?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら？　
{0}君、
支倉先生の生徒さんだったの？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence! So you two know each other.
I wonder how that came about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい偶然！　
二人は知り合いだったのね～
どういう関係なのかしら。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? She's looking after you along with the nursery children...?
What do you mean...? Never mind—some things are better left unasked…
text_block_list.orig_text:
……えっ？　
園児に混じって
お世話されているの……？
それってどういう……
ううん、
聞かない方がいい事もあるわよね……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Today, I was thinking of having everyone get some hands-on experience. Would you like to take on the role of the child for my demonstration, {0}?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は
実習を通じて体験してもらおうと考えていたんだけど、
私がお手本を見せる時、
{0}君には
子ども役をお願いしようかしら。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like fun.
Since you don't come here often, would you mind if I joined in too?
Maybe I could even learn a few tricks to use as a high school teacher.
text_block_list.orig_text:
面白そうね～
せっかくだし、
私も一緒にやってもいいかな？
高校の教師にも活かせるヒントがあるかもしれないし。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Of course you can.
All right. First, let's go outside and get physical!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんですよ。
それじゃあ、
まずはお外で
元気に運動しましょ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Okay, is everybody here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな
揃ったかな～？

text_block_list.name: Male Student 1
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ma'am!
Everyone in Io's class is present and accounted for!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい！
伊緒ちゃんクラス、
全員揃ってまーす！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, what a lovely response.
Well then, let's start off with a nice, friendly game of tag.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
いいお返事ね～
それじゃあ
これから
鬼ごっこを始めようと思います～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: ...But does anyone know what we have to do before that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っと、
その前にしなくちゃいけないこと、
なにか分かる人～？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's absolutely right. Clever boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい、
よく分かりました。
えらいえらい～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Okay, when you're ready.
...One, two, three, four.
Yes, just like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ始めましょう。
……
いっちに～、
さんし～
うん、
その調子よ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Come on, join in, everyone.
Follow {0}'s lead.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ
みんなも一緒に。
{0}君みたいにやるのよ～？

text_block_list.name: Male Student 1
text_block_list.text:
Hngh! Hngh!
Miss Misato, like this?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふんっ、
ふんっ！
美里先生、
こうですかっ！？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
My, my. It's wonderful that you're so full of energy.
But you don't want to push yourself too hard and pull a muscle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら。
元気いっぱいでいいわね～
張り切りすぎて
怪我しないように気を付けるのよ～

text_block_list.name: Male Student 2
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! Aiya!
Miss Misato! Miss Misato!
Check out my abs too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぉらっ！　
せいはぁっ！
美里先生！　
美里先生！
僕の筋肉もっ、
見てください！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what muscles.
But we're still only on warm-ups, so don't go all out yet, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
すごいわね～
でもまだ準備運動なんだから、
ほどほどにね～？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
True, we're only stretching. But {0}, you're going to
have to do a little more than that. I mean, all you do is play games on
your mimi every day. Your body's bound to be stiff.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね、
準備運動だもん。
{0}君は、
それくらいじゃまだ足りないんじゃない？
毎日mimiでゲームばかりして
身体がなまってるはずだよ？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
See, your shoulders are really tight.
Here, let me give you a hand.I'll loosen you right up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
こんなに肩がカチカチに凝ってるじゃない。
先生が手伝ってあげるから
もっと身体をほぐしましょうね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, look at that belly... You've gained a bit of weight.
See? It's all jiggly.
Exercise once in a while, would you? I can be your running buddy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
そのお腹……
ちょっと太ったんじゃない？
ほら、
ぷにぷにしてる。
たまには運動もしよ？　
今度ランニングに付き合ってあげる。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
That goes for everyone—if you're not exercising enough,
be careful, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなも、
運動不足気味な人は念入りにね？

text_block_list.name: Male Students
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁぁぁーーーい！！！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
All right, seems like we're all warmed up now!
Well then, let's all have fun playing tag!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
そろそろ準備運動はいいかな？
それじゃあ、
みんなで元気に
鬼ごっこをやってみましょう～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll be the first to be \"it.\"
Ready? Run, run away! I'm coming to get you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
最初は先生が鬼をやるからね。
さあ、
逃げて逃げて～。
捕まえちゃうわよ～

text_block_list.name: Male Students
text_block_list.text: Wahhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: わぁぁぁ～～！！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
My, my.
You're all too fast. I can't catch anyone.
As expected of high school students. Slow down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら。
みんな足が速くて、
先生追いつけないわ。
さすが高校生ね～
待て待て～

text_block_list.name: Male Student 1
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ma'am, I'll wait!
Actually, I'll come to you!
...Wah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい、
待ちまーす！
てか、
美里先生のとこに行きまーす！
……
わわっ！？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, look out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら
危ないっ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Are you both all right?! Are you injured?
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人とも大丈夫！？　
怪我はない？

text_block_list.name: Male Student 1
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, {0}!
Are you okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}、すまん！
大丈夫だったか？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Lovely. How mature of you both for not getting into a fight.
But it looks like you've grazed your leg.
Can I take a peek at it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
けんかにならずに二人ともえらいわ～
けど
あなたは足を擦りむいたみたいね。
ちょっと診せてみて？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
It might not be bleeding, but it's best to go to the infirmary, just in case.
You have to get it disinfected properly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
血は出てないみたいだけど、
一応保健室に行きましょ？
ちゃんと消毒した方がいいよ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Does it hurt? If you can't walk, I'll give you a piggyback...
I see... That's right, you're a big boy, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
痛くない？　
もし
歩けなかったら
先生がおんぶするから……
そう、
さすが男の子ね～

text_block_list.name: Male Student 1
text_block_list.text: Does he really need two escorts...?
text_block_list.orig_text: 二人も付き添う必要あったか……？

text_block_list.name: Male Student 2
text_block_list.text: Nothing to do with us. Anyway, let's keep playing tag!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあいいじゃないか。
それより、
鬼ごっこを続けようぜ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Listen, I really think I should take a better look.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ、
もっと先生に見せてみて？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Miss Hasekura, examining {0} that closely
is bound to make him feel embarrassed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
支倉先生、
そんなにじっくり見たら、
{0}君もきっと
恥ずかしいわ～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Well, let me just finish off with this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう？　
じゃあ最後にこれだけ……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: And you're all bandaged up, so we're good!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
ばんそうこう貼っておしまい！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
All that worrying has me exhausted.
No one will mind if I take a short rest... *yawn*
text_block_list.orig_text:
安心したら
急に疲れちゃった～
ちょっとだけ、
休んじゃおうかな……
ふぅ～～～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my.
Miss Hasekura...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら～
支倉先生ったら……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: *snore*...
text_block_list.orig_text: すぅ～……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. I imagine that her fatigue has less to do with playing tag
and more with her concern for you.
There, there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
きっと
鬼ごっこで走り回ったあとに、
{0}君の心配をしたから疲れちゃったのね。
よしよし～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Miss Hasekura's...
Or rather, Io's hard work and dedication really touched me today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
支倉先生……
ううん、
頑張ってる伊緒ちゃんの姿に
今日は感動したわ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing how much everyone in her class adores her.
She's really doing her best as a teacher.
text_block_list.orig_text:
クラスのみんなから慕われていてすごいわ。
全力で先生を頑張っているのね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Everyone calls her Io because she thinks that she's too
inexperienced as a teacher, right? 
Heheh. She hasn't changed a bit since college.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな
伊緒ちゃんって呼んでるけど、
まだ自分が先生としては
新人だからってことでしょ？
ふふ、
学生時代から変わってないわ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Even though I was her junior, when we first met, she told me she wasn't senior-like in any way,
so I could just call her Io.
text_block_list.orig_text:
後輩の私にもね、
『先輩らしいところはないから
伊緒ちゃんって呼んでね』って、
初めて会った時に言ったのよ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it just?
I'm sure it's that quality that makes her so popular with children your age.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうよね～。
きっと
伊緒ちゃんのそんなところが、
{0}君たちくらいの子に受け入れられているのね～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
It's funny—I came here today as a guest lecturer,
but it's been a learning experience for me instead.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は特別講師としてこの学校にやって来たのに、
私の方も勉強になったわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Mnn, mnnh...
Goodness, was I sleeping...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
んん～……
やだ、
私
寝ちゃってた……？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Yes, quite soundly.
Are you feeling refreshed at all?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
ぐっすりと～
少しは休めました？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
What?! On your lap, Misato? ...Oh!
Eheheh, I just called you Misato even though I promised to call
you Miss Aikawa in front of everyone today…
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃっ、
美里ちゃんの膝で？　
……あっ！
えへへ、
美里ちゃんって呼んじゃった。
今日はみんなの前だから、
愛川先生って呼ぼうって約束したのに……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
My, my. It's okay, Io.
{0} is the only other person here right now,
so you can call me Misato.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら。
いいですよ、
伊緒ちゃん。
{0}君しかいないから、
今は
美里ちゃんですよ～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Misato. 
Mmmmm. Your lap is so comfortable.
I want to stay like this for a little longer...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、
美里ちゃん。
んん～、
美里ちゃんの膝枕
とっても気持ちいいから、
もうちょっとだけこのままで……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Misato, thanks for coming today.
Being a nursery teacher is tougher than I thought.
Running around with kids like that all day—you're pretty amazing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
美里ちゃん、
今日は来てくれてありがとう。
保育士の仕事って
こんなにも大変だったんだね。
毎日子どもたちとあんな風に走り回ったりして、
美里ちゃんはすごいわ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
No, not really.
I also learned a lot from being here today. I'm so glad I came.
Thank you for inviting me, Io.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
そんなことないですよ～
私も
今日は新しく学んだこともあったから、
来てよかったわ～
誘ってくれてありがとうございます、
伊緒ちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: What did you learn? I thought you came here to teach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
学んだことって？　
美里ちゃんは教えに来たのに。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's a secret.
...Right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ。
それは秘密です。
……ねっ？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Well, we'd best head back to the field...
But your lap is so comfy, it's sad to say goodbye.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ、
そろそろ運動場に戻らなきゃ……
美里ちゃんの膝枕、
気持ちいいから名残惜しいわ～

text_block_list.name: Male Students
text_block_list.text: Wahhhh! Wait up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わあーーー！！　
待て待てーーー！！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. I don't think there's anything to worry about, seeing as
everyone's having so much fun. Maybe the three of us should just take
a nice little siesta right here. {0}, come and lie down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
みんな楽しそうだし
心配なさそうね。
私たちはこのまま
お昼寝の時間にしましょう？
{0}君もベッドにおいで～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you too?
Hold on a second. You're going to take a nap on Misato's lap?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
{0}君も？
ちょっと待って。
美里ちゃんの膝枕でお昼寝？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right.
Like he always does.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ
そうよ～
いつもみたいにね～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Like he always does?
O-okay, we can come back to that later.
But anyway, I'm already lying here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつもみたいにっ？
ううん、
それも気になるけど、
いま私も寝てるんだよ？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
My, my, what's the problem?
I have two legs...
You can both take a nice, friendly afternoon nap together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら～
いいじゃない。
私のお膝は二つ……
二人で仲良くお昼寝してくださいね～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
No matter how you look at it, lying with a student in an infirmary bed 
is definitely not okay!
Don't get ahead of yourselves!
text_block_list.orig_text:
保健室のベッドで
生徒と一緒に寝るだなんて、
そんなの駄目に決まってるじゃない～！
二人ともちょっと待って～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: *yawn*... Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぁぁ～……
あれ？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... It seems like I also suddenly fell asleep...
I had a dream that I made you two sleep on my lap.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら……
私もいつの間にか
寝ちゃってたみたいね……
二人を膝枕する夢を見たわ～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
And I had a dream that you made me sleep on your lap...
So, does that mean we had the same dream?
Huh? Whose lap is this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私はミサト先生に膝枕されて……
じゃあ
もしかして私たち
同じ夢を？
ん、
この膝は……？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my.
It's {0}'s lap.
I wonder if he woke up first and has been quietly watching over us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあらあら～
{0}君の膝枕ね～
私たちより先に起きて、
見守ってくれていたのかしら。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
It feels a little strange sleeping on a student's lap.
It's actually quite reassuring.
text_block_list.orig_text:
生徒に膝枕されるなんて、
不思議な気分ね～
{0}君の膝、
頼もしい感じがするわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, we were searching for a gemstone earlier,
weren't we? So does that mean your memory has returned?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう、
さっきの宝石みたいなものを探していたのよね。
ということは
記憶も戻ったかしら？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Let's give him a test...
Hey, how are you feeling right now?
choice_data_list: I'm curious about that adult picture book.
text_block_list.orig_text:
試してみましょうか……
ねえ、
いまどんな気分？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
So nothing's changed at all...
We've ascended the tower this far, and it's all for naught.
What a shame.
text_block_list.orig_text:
戻らなかったみたいね……
せっかくここまで登ってきたのに
残念だわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: But...
text_block_list.orig_text: でも……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Since this means I'm able to continue teaching you,
I actually feel a little relieved…
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからも{0}君に教えることができるみたいで、
少しほっとしちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: You can stay by my side as a child for a little longer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだ
もう少しだけ、
子どもとして
私のそばに居てくれるのね……

text_block_list.name: Io & Misato
text_block_list.text:
My, my.
...Heheheh.
choice_data_list: What are you two laughing about?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？
……ふふふ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, nothing at all!
As your teachers, We're going to impart to you as much knowledge
as we can... So don't you worry. Isn't that right, Miss Misato?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
なんでもないの！
これからも
先生として色んなことを教えていくから……
だから、
心配しないで。
そうですよね、
ミサト先生？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely.
Now, let's go home and take a well-deserved rest.
You're always working so hard. What a good boy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
もちろんです。
さあ
今日は帰って、
ゆっくり休みましょう～
いつもよく頑張っていて、
えらいえらい～

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
With two reliable teachers taking him by the hand, 
{0} left the Tower of Luna, until another day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人の頼もしい先生に手を引かれ、
{0}はルナの塔を後にするのだった。
